**2026 -- 2028** &nbsp;·&nbsp; *Biodiversa+ pilot*

MetaBUG is one of the [Biodiversa+](../biodiversa-plus/index.qmd) monitoring pilots. Over three years, partners in 13 countries catch insects in Malaise traps and identify them by DNA metabarcoding, testing how the method can support insect monitoring across Europe.

It runs alongside the [BiodivPond](../biodivpond/index.qmd) pilot, which tests eDNA for ponds, in the same cluster of transnational biodiversity monitoring.
